name: Rashid - wheat and rice grower
subtitle: Age 42  ·  30 acres, Sahiwal district, Punjab  ·  buys 12-15 bags a season
household: Married, three children; his eldest helps in the field and handles his phone.
Owns his land; rents a tractor at sowing.
Source of the definition: brief p23 (male farmers 25-55, 12-150+ acres).
mindset: Decides by what he has seen work on land like his, not by what a brand claims.
Fears waste more than failure: a season lost cannot be recovered.

pain_points.title: Will it lock up if I mix it
pain_points.detail: Asks whether NP mixed with zinc urea or potash will react and waste the bag.
pain_points.evidence: 220 of 1,433 comments (15.4%), the largest theme; verbatim in comments/analysis.md §3

pain_points.title: Every expert says something different
pain_points.detail: Creators contradict each other and the company's own field practice.

triggers.title: The irrigation calendar
triggers.detail: Buys against sowing and first irrigation, not against a campaign date.
triggers.evidence: 163 timing and dose comments; brief p6 Rabi Oct-Mar, Kharif Apr-Sep

interests.title: Interests and affinity index
interests.gap: No interest-affinity dataset covers this audience. The nearest export describes an urban news site's web visitors, so it is not used here. To fill this: a rural media or U&A study from the client.

items.note: watches agronomy creators and comments there; asks strangers what the maker should tell him
the last conversation before the bag is bought

conclusion: He is not waiting to be persuaded that the product works. He is waiting to be shown how to use it without losing a season.
